{{Icon|Combustion icon|'''Combustion'''}} is a type of debuff applied by both operators and enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator applies {{G|Heat Infliction}} to an enemy with Non-Heat Infliction, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} all Non-Heat Infliction stacks and apply Combustion: Deals {{Color|160% – 400% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Heat DMG|3}} of the triggering operator on application and {{Color|24% – 60% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Heat DMG|3}} of the triggering operator per second for {{Color|10|1d}}s.

The following table shows the amount of damage dealt to the target on application and over time based on the {{G|Status Level}} or the amount of Non-Heat Infliction stacks consumed:

!Heat DMG Application

|{{Color|24% ATK|1d}} / second

|-

|{{Color|48% ATK|1d}} / second

|{{Color|60% ATK|1d}} / second
|}

Combustion can be <u>forcibly applied</u> by some operators without requiring Non-Heat Infliction stacks. Forced Combustion does not deal the Heat DMG instance, deals {{Color|24% ATK|1d}} per second for {{Color|10|1d}}s, and is treated as Status Level I. The resulting damage over time and duration from a Forced Combustion may be increased by some operator abilities such as {{Icon|Laevatain icon|{{C|Laevatain}}}}'s {{Icon|Potential 4|{{Color|Fragments of the Past|7}}}}.

Applying Combustion to a target with existing Combustion overrides the previous effect regardles of Status Level and resets the debuff's duration.

==Hostile Combustion==
{{Quote|''Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of Heat Infliction to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes Combusted: Temporarily suffer continuous Heat DMG that ignores DEF.''|Tutorial}}
Some [[Enemies]] or stage mechanics are capable of applying Heat Infliction or Combustion to Operators. When an Operator reaches 4 stacks of Heat Inflictions, the stacks are removed and the Operator becomes Combusted: 
* The debuff lasts for {{Color|8|1d}} seconds (unless otherwise specified).
* Deals an initial instance of {{Color|[4% of Operator's Max HP]|1d}} as {{Color|Heat DMG|3}}.
* Deals {{Color|[2% of Operator's Max HP]|1d}} per second as {{Color|Heat DMG|3}}.
* The initial instance and damage over time ignores the Operator's [[Defense]] but can still be modified by other effects such as Heat Resistance, Heat DMG Reduction, or {{G|Protect}}.
** The damage done ignores Defense by treating the Defense stat value of the Operator as 0.
** The [[Critical Rate]] of the damage is also set to 0%. Though as all enemies have a Critical Rate of 0%, this has no effect.  

* While under the effects of [[Combustion]], the Operators cannot receive any further [[Heat Infliction|Heat Inflictions]]. The combustion effect is visualized by an <span style="background-color:#ff880088;">orange-red</span> health bar and the Operator's model burning in orange flames.
